data.strain_convention: engineering shear strains 2epsilon_yz,2epsilon_xz,2epsilon_xy;stiffness is the physical C_ijkl under the standard Voigt mapping,not a matrix to rescale when forming the Christoffel contraction.

data.propagation_sector: n is a Cartesian unit propagation normal in the IEEE basis with n_z=0 and 0<n_y<n_x. Boundaries n_y=0 and n_x=n_y are excluded. Count only this symmetry-reduced open sector.
data.wave_model: Homogeneous long-wavelength linear-elastic bulk waves. Form the unnormalized Christoffel matrix A_ik=C_ijkl*n_j*n_l;its eigenvalues are rho*v². An acoustic axis has two equal eigenvalues,not merely a pure transverse polarization. Ignore dispersion,damping and all finite-q atomistic corrections.
data.claim_scope: Computed-source elastic continuum inference,not an experimental measurement or a certification of all acoustic axes in the full sphere.

provenance.kind: authentic published DFT elasticity projection with a controlled elastic-wave follow-up
provenance.generation: Lossless selected original published computational-data projection; no synthetic numerical observations. Source captures identify the original bytes. Any derived coordinate or format metadata is explicitly marked. These are computational inputs,not new experimental measurements.
provenance.units: C and unnormalized Christoffel eigenvalues GPa;densityg/cm³;phase speedm/s;Cartesian propagation normal dimensionless
